Wham! "Last Christmas" is already No.12 on Spotify's US daily chart (629,509 streams, Nov 5, 2026), six spots ahead of Mariah Carey's "All I Want for Christmas Is You" at No.18 (552,607).

Christmas is back on Spotify: on Nov 7, Wham! gained 543,812 monthly listeners in a day, the most of any artist. Brenda Lee, Mariah Carey and Michael Bublé are also in the top 5.

All-time, Mariah still leads: 2.15B streams on Spotify's global weekly chart vs 1.84B for Last Christmas.

Who owns Christmas, Wham! or Mariah?

Data: Spotify charts and listeners via kworb · Nov 5-7, 2026
